title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1982-07-25
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with standout Black Peter→Good Lovin' transition and emotional Lost Sailor, captured on a solid audience FOBradio recording.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its strong set list, tight transitions (notably Black Peter into Good Lovin') and moving moments like Lost Sailor that even brought listeners to tears. The audience‑recorded tape using Wise’s Sennheiser 421s is described as spot‑on despite a slight cymbal loss, making it an enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are largely enthusiastic about both the musical performance and the recording; one outlier low rating is outweighed by four positive comments, leading to a solid above‑average overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with Wise’s Sennheiser 421 mics close to the board; clear and spot‑on overall, though cymbals are a bit recessed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid set list with smooth transitions; the second half of the show especially highlighted strong sequencing and emotional moments.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s unexpected lyrical interjection during Lost Sailor ('freedom not comin' easy…25 cent cup of coffee') was highlighted as a memorable, emotional moment.
